configurations.//: Serves the already-rendered _site/ as static files with caching disabled. Deliberately NOT `quarto preview`: that command renders into memory and serves its own copy, so it either overwrites _site behind your back (default) or serves permanently stale HTML (--no-watch-inputs). With a static server there is exactly one writer, `quarto render`, and the browser always sees what is actually on disk. Render explicitly after editing.
configurations.name: quarto-preview
